# Schematic pinout

Status: Stage 4 capture contract, 2026-10-08. This table mirrors schematic.intent.json; completion requires actual schematic generation and clean symbol/ERC/legibility/drift reports. The ten fitted parts remain UNVERIFIED for physical release. No PCB or physical prototype is created by schematic capture.

## Intentional no-connects

- J1.A6, J1.B6: D+; J1.A7, J1.B7: D-; J1.A8, J1.B8: SBU. Rationale: power-only input, no USB data or alternate mode.
- U1.3: active-low open-drain FLT. Rationale: no fault-status observer or pull-up is fitted, avoiding an unnecessary current path.

## Capture rationale and limits

- All four J1 VBUS contacts feed U1 IN and active-high EN through VBUS_RAW; only U1 OUT feeds both external outputs, C2 and the LED branch. Rationale: retain one common active protection domain with no bypass.
- All four J1 ground contacts plus S1 shield connect directly to GND. Rationale: explicit bench-prototype shell treatment, without an EMC/ESD qualification claim.
- R1 and R2 are independent 5.1k Rd terminations for CC1 and CC2. Rationale: support both orientations without joining CC or asserting current negotiation.
- J2 pin 1 is positive and pin 2 ground. J3 pins 1/3 are positive and 2/4 ground. Rationale: consistent polarity; actual board rotation, silkscreen and mating still require review.
- R4 pin 1 is protected power; R4 pin 2 feeds D1 anode pin 2 via LED_A; D1 cathode pin 1 goes to ground. Rationale: indicator follows the protected rail.
- R3/ILIM_SET, EN resistor and FLT pull-up are intentionally absent. Rationale: TPS2065C uses a fixed limit and direct active-high enable; no obsolete programming path is needed.
- A known-capable 4.75-5.25 V source/cable must supply 500 mA total external load plus overhead/startup. Strict <2 mA unloaded VBUS remains a required but physically unverified target; the 0.831 mA conditional ledger is not a measurement or guaranteed maximum.
- Output backfeed and paralleled supplies remain prohibited. Fault/thermal/recovery, brightness, leakage, assembly and complete loaded drop are unqualified.
- This analog ten-part circuit has no MCU, programmable device or firmware. Preserve the real later firmware-stage result; no dummy firmware is required.

Exact MPNs, footprints, source conditions and pending release checks: docs/BOM.md. Subsystem descriptions: docs/SUBSYSTEMS.md. Requirements: docs/SPEC.md.
